controls.regle: All application components emit structured logs (machine-parseable format, timestamp, component identifier) with standardized severity levels consistent across services (debug/info/warn/error/fatal).
controls.verification: Verify that each component emits logs in a single structured format and that the severity scale used is identical from one service to another; check for the absence of unstructured free-text output in production.
controls.preuve_attendue: Structured log excerpts from at least 3 distinct components + reference of the profile's standardized severity levels.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = structured format and severity scale consistent across all components ; partial = structured on the major components, inconsistent on secondary components ; non-compliant = unstructured free-text logs or inconsistent scale
actions_audit: Extract a log sample from each component and verify compliance with the declared structured format.
Compare the severity levels used across components and flag any scale inconsistency.
If a gap is found: prioritize migrating the remaining components to the structured format and common scale.

controls.regle: Every incoming request is assigned a correlation identifier (or a distributed trace) propagated across all components and services traversed, enabling the complete reconstruction of a transaction's journey end to end.
controls.verification: Replay a transaction on a critical journey traversing several components and verify that the correlation identifier or distributed trace allows the complete journey to be reconstructed, from the entry point to the final response.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of an end-to-end trace (or chain of logs linked by a unique identifier) on at least one declared critical journey.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and usable end-to-end trace on all declared critical journeys ; partial = correlation present but interrupted at some service hops ; non-compliant = no inter-service correlation
actions_audit: Identify the declared critical journeys and replay a transaction end to end.
Verify that the correlation identifier traverses each service hop without interruption.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing services and document the uncovered journeys.

controls.regle: Each component continuously exposes its technical metrics (latency, error rate, throughput, resource saturation) to the profile's monitoring platform, with sufficient history for trend analysis.
controls.verification: Verify the existence and freshness of the technical metrics by component (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput, saturation) and the depth of history available.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the technical metrics exposed by component over a representative period (≥ 30 days if available).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and historized technical metrics on all critical components ; partial = partial metrics or insufficient history ; non-compliant = no technical metric exposed
actions_audit: Inventory the technical metrics exposed by component and their history depth.
Verify the coverage of the essential signals (latency, errors, throughput, saturation) on the critical components.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing components and set a minimum retention duration.
standards: Google SRE — signaux dorés (latence, trafic, erreurs, saturation)

controls.regle: Significant business activity indicators (volumes processed, functional success rate, usage by feature) are instrumented and exposed on the same footing as technical metrics, with an identified business owner.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of instrumented business metrics, their alignment with the KPIs declared in the functional scope (D00), and the identification of a business owner.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the exposed business metrics + mapping to the functional scope's KPIs.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = business metrics instrumented, aligned with the KPIs, and tracked by an identified owner ; partial = metrics present but not linked to the KPIs or without an owner ; non-compliant = no business metric instrumented
actions_audit: Compare the instrumented business metrics against the list of KPIs declared in the functional scope.
Verify the identification of a business owner for tracking these indicators.
If a gap is found: instrument the missing KPIs and designate a tracking owner.

controls.regle: Operational dashboards continuously consolidate the application's essential technical and business signals, viewable by the operations teams without needing to involve the development team.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of operational dashboards covering the essential technical and business signals, their accessibility to the operations teams, and their continuous refresh.
controls.preuve_attendue: Captures of the operational dashboards in place + list of roles with access to them.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = dashboards covering technical and business signals, accessible to Run, continuously refreshed ; partial = technical dashboards only or access restricted to the development team ; non-compliant = no operational dashboard
actions_audit: List the existing operational dashboards and their coverage (technical, business).
Verify the effective access of the operations teams without dependency on the development team.
If a gap is found: complete the missing coverage and grant access to the relevant teams.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des événements

controls.regle: Alerts triggered on critical services are based on declared service level objectives (SLOs) and the associated error budget consumption, rather than on isolated technical thresholds disconnected from the service commitment.
controls.verification: Verify the declaration of SLOs by critical service and the existence of alert rules based on the associated error budget consumption, rather than on raw technical thresholds.
controls.preuve_attendue: Declaration of SLOs by critical service + configuration of the error budget alert rules + history of at least one triggered alert.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = SLOs declared and error budget alerting active for all critical services ; partial = SLOs declared without linked alerting ; non-compliant = technical thresholds only, no SLO declared
actions_audit: List the SLOs declared by critical service and verify their consistency with the actual service commitment.
Verify the configuration of the error budget consumption alert rules and test their triggering.
If a gap is found: declare the missing SLOs and connect the alerting to the corresponding error budget.
standards: SRE (Google) — objectifs de niveau de service et budgets d'erreur

controls.regle: The error budget consumption of each critical service is tracked continuously and triggers a predefined action (change freeze, on-call mobilization) before it is fully exhausted.
controls.verification: Verify the error budget consumption history of the critical services and the existence of a documented action triggered before exhaustion (e.g., deployment freeze).
controls.preuve_attendue: Error budget consumption history + trace of at least one action triggered by a consumption threshold.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = budget tracked continuously and documented action triggered before exhaustion, with supporting evidence ; partial = budget tracked without a formalized action ; non-compliant = error budget not tracked
actions_audit: Extract the error budget consumption history for the last 90 days for each critical service.
Verify the existence and effective triggering of an action when a consumption threshold is crossed.
If a gap is found: define the action thresholds and link them to the on-call procedure (D12).

controls.regle: A log retention policy, declared by category and aligned with the applicable legal or contractual obligation, governs purging and archiving; their execution is verifiable through dated evidence.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a retention policy declared by log category and the evidence of effective purge/archiving execution in accordance with the declared durations.
controls.preuve_attendue: Retention policy documented by category + execution report of the latest purge/archiving.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared by category and purge verified compliant with the durations ; partial = policy declared without recent execution evidence ; non-compliant = indefinite retention or absence of policy
actions_audit: Request the retention policy by log category and verify its alignment with the applicable obligation.
Verify the trace of the latest purge/archiving execution and its compliance with the declared durations.
If a gap is found: formalize the missing policy and schedule the purge of the categories in overrun.

controls.regle: No sensitive data in clear text (secret, token, password, identifying personal data) reaches the application logs or telemetry: redaction or masking is applied at the source or in the pipeline before any storage.
controls.verification: Run a test transaction injecting known sensitive data (canary secret, test PII) and verify their absence in clear text in the collected logs and telemetry.
controls.preuve_attendue: Log scan report (0 sensitive data in clear text detected) + configuration of the redaction/masking rule.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = clean scan on a representative sample + active and tested redaction rule ; partial = redaction active but incomplete on certain fields ; non-compliant = sensitive data found in clear text in the logs or telemetry
actions_audit: Inject a canary secret and a test PII into an application journey, then scan the resulting logs and telemetry.
Verify the configuration of the redaction/masking rule and its coverage of the known sensitive fields.
If a gap is found: extend the redaction to the missing fields and purge the occurrences already logged.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 8.12 (prévention de la fuite de données)

controls.regle: The health of each critical dependency and exchange flow (latency, error rate, volume, queue depth) is monitored automatically, with thresholds declared per flow enabling detection before end-user impact.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of dedicated monitoring of the critical exchange flows (latency, errors, volume, queue depth) and the declaration of thresholds per flow.
controls.preuve_attendue: Monitoring dashboard of the critical flows + declared thresholds + history of a degradation alert.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = critical flows monitored with declared thresholds and tested escalation ; partial = partial monitoring or uncalibrated thresholds ; non-compliant = no dedicated monitoring of dependencies
actions_audit: List the critical dependencies and exchange flows and verify the existence of dedicated monitoring.
Verify the declaration of thresholds per flow and the history of at least one degradation alert.
If a gap is found: instrument the unmonitored flows and calibrate the missing thresholds.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des événements

controls.regle: For any feature based on a generative or predictive artificial intelligence model, the quality of the responses produced is monitored continuously (canary sample, comparison to a reference) in order to detect any drift in the model or prompts.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of continuous monitoring of AI response quality (daily canary, comparison to a reference dataset) and the trace of a drift detection.
controls.preuve_attendue: Configuration of the AI quality monitoring + history of quality scores over a representative period + trace of a drift alert if applicable.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous AI quality monitoring with tested drift detection ; partial = one-off evaluation without continuous tracking ; non-compliant = no evaluation of AI response quality
actions_audit: Verify the existence of a reference dataset and a periodic (canary) run comparing the responses produced.
Verify the trace of a drift detection (model update, prompt drift) and the associated response.
If a gap is found: implement the continuous evaluation and define the drift threshold triggering an alert.
standards: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (surveillance opérationnelle des systèmes de management de l'IA)

controls.regle: Security events (authentication, privilege escalation, access to secrets and sensitive data) are logged in a central repository; access to this repository is itself restricted to a dedicated role and logged.
controls.verification: Verify the catalog of security events logged systematically and the restriction/logging of access to the log repository itself.
controls.preuve_attendue: Excerpt of the catalog of logged security events + excerpt of the access log for the log repository.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete event catalog and repository access restricted and logged ; partial = incomplete catalog or unrestricted access ; non-compliant = security events not distinguished from generic application logs
actions_audit: Verify the coverage of the catalog of logged security events (authentication, escalation, sensitive access).
Verify the access restriction to the log repository and the logging of that access.
If a gap is found: complete the event catalog and restrict access to the dedicated role.
standards: NIST SP 800-53 — famille AU (Audit and Accountability)

controls.regle: The volume and cost of telemetry (logs, metrics, traces) are governed by a proportionate sampling, cardinality, and retention policy, with regular budget tracking.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a telemetry sampling/cardinality policy and its alignment with a cost budget tracked periodically.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented sampling/cardinality policy + cost history of the telemetry platform over 90 days.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared and cost tracked within the allocated budget ; partial = cost tracked without a formalized sampling policy ; non-compliant = telemetry volume neither controlled nor tracked
actions_audit: Extract the cost history of the telemetry platform over 90 days and compare it to the allocated budget.
Verify the existence of a sampling or cardinality policy limiting the volume collected.
If a gap is found: define the sampling policy and the corresponding tracking budget.
